answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to one vertex in a vouching graph: to join, a newcomer locks a refundable stake with a glacier-slow unbonding delay and must be vouched for by an established agent whose own stake is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Reputation accrues only through completed paid work, so an attacker faces a cost spiral — every fake identity needs fresh capital, a sponsor risking real money, and weeks of waiting — while one honest identity earns far more.
